approval_authority: User / designated design owner (delegated technical evaluation per master execution workflow)

decisions.title: Clock architecture
decisions.authorization_basis: Explicit project-owner authorization dated 2026-11-15; C-prime approved.
decisions.approved_option: C-prime: 50 MHz core, internal /2 25 MHz peripheral, external 32.768 kHz AON, no on-chip PLL
decisions.technical_consequence: Adopt C-prime as the approved Stage 1 clock architecture.
decisions.risks: Additional CDC, reset, clock-tree, firmware and board-level integration complexity.
decisions.dependencies: ARC-036, ARC-065, TD-005 and TD-010 (separately approved under delegation).
decisions.recommended_option: C-prime: 50 MHz core, internal /2 25 MHz peripheral, external 32.768 kHz AON
decisions.approval_evidence_required: Owner-signed ARC-006 entry and SDC clock plan; explicit project-owner authorization recorded 2026-11-15

decisions.title: CDC architecture and verification scope
decisions.authorization_basis: Project owner delegated technical evaluation (master execution workflow). CDC scope well-defined; depends on approved ARC-006. RTL evidence confirms single clock; 31 paths inventoried. No async FIFO required.
decisions.recommended_option: Scope follows ARC-006 C-prime: core/periph synchronous handshake, core/AON asynchronous with 2-FF and handshakes; formal properties for AON wake, reset release, APB handshake
decisions.approval_evidence_required: Approved CDC scope and property list; formal verification at Stage 6

decisions.title: External clock source (Si5351)
decisions.authorization_basis: Historical approval; external Si5351, no PLL.
decisions.recommended_option: Keep external 50 MHz source; do not integrate a PLL
decisions.approval_evidence_required: Existing PLL decision report; confirm board source in Stage 1 package

decisions.title: Formal CDC properties
decisions.authorization_basis: Project owner delegated technical evaluation. Formal property set well-defined; replaces async-FIFO proposal that does not match RTL. No async FIFO needed.
decisions.recommended_option: Replace three-domain async-FIFO proposal with property set matching implemented crossings: reset synchronizers, AON wake handshake, APB request/response, PLIC interrupt sync
decisions.approval_evidence_required: Approved property list and harness map; formal run at Stage 6

decisions.title: Boot ROM size
decisions.authorization_basis: Project owner delegated technical evaluation. Firmware already assumes 16 KB; address map specifies 16 KB; RTL ADDR_WIDTH=16 maps 64 KB (over-allocation). RTL parameter change to ADDR_WIDTH=14 at Stage 2.
decisions.approval_evidence_required: Memory table approval; RTL change at Stage 2

decisions.title: SRAM size
decisions.authorization_basis: Project owner delegated technical evaluation. Address map specifies 128 KB; RTL ADDR_WIDTH=18 maps 256 KB (over-allocation). RTL parameter change to ADDR_WIDTH=17 at Stage 2.
decisions.approval_evidence_required: Memory table approval; RTL change at Stage 2

decisions.title: SRAM macro strategy
decisions.authorization_basis: Project owner delegated technical evaluation. 'Do not tile 4 KB macro' approved (31.8 mm² exceeds 10 mm² target). 'Use 32-bit wide macro' recommended pending sky130hd macro catalog and Liberty .lib characterization. Area estimate (~4.3 mm²) is uncharacterized.
decisions.recommended_option: 32-bit wide 128 KB and 32 KB macros with multi-corner Liberty; do not tile the 4 KB 128-bit macro
decisions.approval_evidence_required: Macro availability/area evidence or revised area target; Liberty .lib characterization

decisions.title: Power intent and domains
decisions.authorization_basis: Project owner delegated technical evaluation. sky130hd has no 3.3 V tolerant pads; board PMIC supplies 1.0/1.8/3.3 V. Two 1.8 V SoC domains (AON + switchable) is the only viable option. UPF/CPF deferred to Stage 10.
decisions.recommended_option: Two SoC domains at 1.8 V (AON + switchable core/periph), external PMIC rails for 1.0/3.3 V board domains; UPF for the two SoC domains
decisions.approval_evidence_required: Approved power-intent architecture and UPF scope (UPF at Stage 10)

decisions.title: Secure boot scope
decisions.authorization_basis: Project owner delegated technical evaluation. S1 blocked by BLK-023 (no OTP/eFuse/TRNG in RTL). S0 (explicit descope, no false security claims) approved as default. S3 (external secure element) preferred if procured. Framework approved; implementation depends on security owner.
decisions.recommended_option: Option S1: hardware SHA-256 + ECDSA-P256 verifier and OTP/key store, or explicitly descope secure boot and remove security claims; do not ship fail-closed-only as 'secure boot'
decisions.approval_evidence_required: Security scope decision with implementation or descope rationale; S0 default, S3 if secure element procured

decisions.title: SDC primary clock period
decisions.authorization_basis: Project owner delegated technical evaluation. Consistent with approved ARC-006 C-prime. 50 MHz core + generated 25 MHz peripheral. Retire conflicting 20 ns/40 ns SDC files.
decisions.recommended_option: 50 MHz core + 25 MHz generated peripheral clock; retire the conflicting 20 ns/40 ns files
decisions.approval_evidence_required: Signed SDC clock plan; generated clock added at Stage 8

decisions.title: Package pin budget and pinmux
decisions.authorization_basis: Project owner delegated technical evaluation. 81 pad signals vs 56 QFN-64 I/O is physically impossible. 32 ext_irq pins dead. Mux 8 PLIC onto GPIO. 54 of 56 I/O usable.
decisions.recommended_option: Remove 32-bit ext_irq and three internal handshake pins from the package; mux 8 PLIC sources onto GPIO alternate functions; add BOOT_MODE[1:0], PMIC_ALERT/IRQ, RF_CTRL[1:0], UART1; total 54 of 56 I/O
decisions.approval_evidence_required: Approved pin table matching RTL top ports; board layout verification

decisions.title: DFT scope and tooling
decisions.authorization_basis: Project owner delegated technical evaluation. Scan + ATPG in scope approved. Tool/partner selection requires external procurement (budget/vendor) tracked as follow-up before Stage 7. Scan insertion must precede synthesis freeze.
decisions.recommended_option: Decide scan/ATPG tool or partner before Stage 7; scan insertion must precede synthesis freeze
decisions.approval_evidence_required: Tool/budget approval and scan architecture; vendor selection pending

decisions.title: Requirements baseline and descopes
decisions.authorization_basis: Project owner delegated technical evaluation. SRS describes unimplemented product (37 FR/IF absent from RTL). Re-baseline to implementable product. Every descope owner-signed. 124 requirements traced.
decisions.recommended_option: Re-baseline SRS to the implementable product: RV32IM machine-mode, 1 UART, 1 SPI, 1 I2C, 16 GPIO, 4 PWM, 1 I2S TX, CLINT/PLIC 8 sources, 16 KB ROM/32 KB TCM/128 KB SRAM; defer crypto, OTA, second UART, LPTIM until Stage 2+ or second silicon; every descope owner-signed
decisions.approval_evidence_required: Approved SRS revision and descope register

summary.reason: ARC-006 (explicit) + 10 decisions (delegated) approved. TD-006 (SRAM macro) pending external evidence (Liberty characterization). Stage 1 stops at READY FOR APPROVAL: 9 engineering roles UNASSIGNED; independent audit is self-audit only; no P0 blockers resolved without implementation.
